method: Sequential invocation of actual configured PreToolUse handlers; identical commands, fixture bytes, cwd, and context. Candidate commands were never executed. Session/tool IDs omitted to isolate per-command analysis from session policy. Host and process state uncontrolled.
limitations: Authored regression corpus, not an unbiased general accuracy benchmark
Several routine profiles were added after examining baseline gaps
Known impact does not imply complete coverage
Old handler was direct Rust; new handler includes isolated Python startup and SHA-256 pin validation
Timestamp fields retain the machine clock reported during measurement
